concept.title: LoRA Adapter Effect
concept.answer: A LoRA adapter changes what a model says by adding small low-rank trainable matrices to the frozen base weights, steering its style, tone and knowledge without full retraining. The base model stays the same and the adapter modifies how it generates outputs.

items.label: Low-rank update
items.detail: Adds trainable A and B matrices to frozen weights for efficient steering.

items.label: Base model frozen
items.detail: Original weights stay unchanged, adapter is plugged in at inference.

items.label: Behavior shift
items.detail: Changes style, tone, domain knowledge or persona of generated text.

items.label: Composable
items.detail: Multiple adapters can be swapped or combined for different outputs.
